0.description: All connections rejected (flag=REJ, rerror_rate=1.0). High connection count (121) to many destination hosts (255) with few services (4). Classic scanning behavior where attacker probes for open ports/services and gets rejected.

1.mitre_technique: T1499 (Endpoint DoS) / T1498 (Network Denial of Service)
1.key_indicators: TCP, service=private, flag=S0 (SYN), serror_rate=1.0, count=199, srv_count=11
1.description: All connections are SYN packets (flag=S0) with 100% SYN error rate (serror_rate=1.0). High volume (count=199) across multiple services (11). Classic SYN flood DoS pattern where attacker sends SYN packets without completing handshake.

2.description: ICMP traffic (protocol_type=icmp) with successful connections (flag=SF). Very high srv_count=99 with 100% same_srv_rate - single source connecting to many services on same host. ICMP echo reply (ecr_i) scanning/enumeration pattern.

3.mitre_technique: T1595.001 (Active Scanning: Scanning IP Blocks) / T1018 (Remote System Discovery)
3.key_indicators: ICMP, service=eco_i, flag=SF, src_bytes=8, count=1, srv_count=6
3.description: ICMP echo requests (eco_i) with successful responses (flag=SF). Low byte count (src_bytes=8 = typical ping packet). Low connection count (1) but multiple services (6). Classic ping sweep for host discovery.

normal.key_indicators: Mixed flags (SF, REJ, RSTO), low error rates, varied services, normal byte counts, logged_in=1 for authenticated services
